thinking_stances_applied.result: Pressure the verification-to-cleanup boundary with a logically incomplete but structurally healthy graph. verify_migration checks nonzero nodes when staged nodes were nonzero, SQLite integrity, vector consistency and sample semantic queries; those checks alone do not establish edges, extraction state, communities or source completeness.

Reuse the staged builder proof as a typed participant manifest: record generation, source manifest digest and graph/edge/community digests, then verify an identical published generation against it. If legitimate reconciliation advances generation, require its own complete participant proof rather than compare to stale counts.

Keep the resident snapshot and the one-database transaction. Avoid reintroducing a second shipped graph engine or migration decoder. Strengthen proof at the existing verification seam rather than duplicating extraction during every routine read.

The intended invariant is one authoritative publication, not merely one filename. Revalidate that all advertised completeness states, cleanup permission and response caches derive from the same publication identity; map output remains an external derived artifact requiring its own receipt consistency.

Treat migration like deployment of a signed artifact: staging validates contents, activation changes authority, and post-activation health must prove the activated artifact, not just process liveness. SQLite quick_check and nonzero nodes correspond to liveness, while participant/source proofs correspond to readiness.

primer.best_alternative: Retain the shared SQLite design and current migration protocol. At staging, bind a compact manifest of participant counts/digests and source/version provenance to the completed publication. At verification, validate the manifest for the current generation, explicitly replacing it only through a completed reconciliation transaction. Gate cleanup on this proof and representative graph queries in the fresh process. This is better because it verifies the exact semantic property cleanup relies on without shipping legacy graph conversion. Cost: extra digest work and careful treatment of a legitimate intervening build; do not require equality to obsolete staging counts after generation advances.
